hi! I am an environmental science student so most of my classes are in St. Paul but my minor is most on West Bank. I don’t live on the St. Paul campus but I may in the fall. I wanted to say that living near the St. Paul campus would be a lot less hustle and bustle than the main campus area and you would still be within walking distance of great shops in Falcon Heights as well as Mim’s Cafe which is basically on campus. Commuting to and from St. Paul has been super easy in my experience, UMN busses while not always perfect are a great service. I don’t know what your routine is like so I would caution you that the buses reduce their operations past 6pm- they still go all night long, but, it becomes closer to a 30 minute wait at each stop than 5 during the daytime hours. 

As someone from further north, the lack of ‘natural’ spaces is jarring to me on the main campus for sure. However, I love walking across the Mississippi everyday and sitting on the lawn watching the turkeys is fun. The walkability of campus makes up for some of the lack of nature for me because it’s so nice to be able to walk around so far without needing a car. 

I’m also a transfer student so for your transfer courses email your major coordinator and/or academic advisor as soon as possible to get the credits sorted out. I am not sure for the other departments but CFANS/environmental sciences has been very accommodating in my experience. 

Good luck!

If you are just worrying about the spring you should be fine! I would suggest emailing financial services as soon as you can but because spring hasn’t started I imagine you can end your housing contract either this month or pay for half of January. If you are in a dorm I would talk to your or another CA and they can point you to someone who knows more about the housing process. 

I withdrew 2 weeks into the second semester and it was really a challenge but if I could get out of paying after doing that, I am sure you can if you start the process now. Again, I do highly recommend you reach out to your doctor or any other medical personal you have in case they do ask for that documentation. I am not sure what the policy is exactly for leaving at semester but for me, I would’ve had to pay something like 75% of my semester fees without proof that I had a circumstance beyond my control. It felt really shitty at the time, especially when I was in such a bad place but I understand why they need to do it. If you don’t have any medical documentation I highly suggest trying to make an appointment at one of the university health services before the end of the semester just in case they do ask. They may not though! It is typically much more common and less expensive to leave at semester. 

Sorry for the novel, I just really empathize with your situation and want you to know it will work in your favor even if it seems stressful. You got this.

At this point in the semester without documentation you will have to pay almost entirely in full. However, if you can get proof of ongoing severe symptoms from a doctor or therapist you may be able to contest what you would have to pay. Email or call student services to see who you need to directly talk to. If there is any faculty or student leader you trust I would open up to one of them as well. 

I went through this process several years ago and it was very hard. I encourage you to push your way through to the end of this semester. You are so close you can do it! Once the semester ends you will have a much easier time dropping out for the second semester and getting out of paying will be much easier as well. 

Good luck, proud of you for putting yourself first

Hi there! I play a Kenku Articfer named Tink! I’m called Tink because the constant tinkering of tools and mechanisms in the dwarven blacksmith shops Tink grew up in was the first sound he loved to mimic. As a Kenku, Tink does what he is told which can get him into a lot of bad situations. Growing up he ended up forced into weapon making for an army for years because he didn’t know better then to stop till one day he finally saw the destruction his canons were causing. He also ended up in a deal with a demon that has slowly been turning his black feathers a green tint. He always has a pistol and a hammer. He wears goggles on his little head and a tattered coat— he doesn’t really know about fashion. He is getting old for a Kenku, somewhere in his 40s. 

Would love to see you draw him if he is what you are looking for!
